summary.lv: Atea Global Services meklē Data Engineer ar 5+ gadu pieredzi, kurš izstrādās un uzturēs datu cauruļvadus un ETL/ELT procesus Microsoft Fabric platformā, atbalstot uzņēmuma pāreju uz datu vadītu un MI iespējotu organizāciju.
summary.en: Atea Global Services seeks a Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to build and maintain data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes on Microsoft Fabric, supporting the company's transformation toward a data-driven and AI-enabled organization.
